  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(t_d1pad_sh_cpu, Array(t_d1pad_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(t_d1pad_val_cpu, Array(t_d1pad_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(dec1out_sh_cpu, Array(dec1out_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(dec1out_val_cpu, Array(dec1out_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(y_sh_cpu, Array(y_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(y_val_cpu, Array(y_val_gpu)))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
  push!(SAMPLES, (__rep, __trial, local_max))
end

# per-trial (same shadow seed, 8 independent GPU executions) -- isolates atomic
# ordering noise from seed-to-seed variation
byt = Dict{Int,Vector{Float64}}()
for (r, t, v) in SAMPLES
    push!(get!(byt, t, Float64[]), v)
end
per_trial = Dict(string("trial", t) => Dict(
        "min" => minimum(v), "max" => maximum(v),
        "spread_x" => maximum(v) / max(minimum(v), 1e-30)) for (t, v) in byt)
allv = Float64[v for (_, _, v) in SAMPLES]
println(JSON3.write(Dict(
    "kernel" => "unet_repeat", "rtol" => 1.075e-12, "n_samples" => length(allv),
    "overall_min" => minimum(allv), "overall_max" => maximum(allv),
    "overall_spread_x" => maximum(allv) / max(minimum(allv), 1e-30),
    "n_over_rtol" => count(v -> v > 1.075e-12, allv),
    "per_trial" => per_trial,
    "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
